messages.subject: Conditional Panel with two conditions
parts:
Hi,

I have been trying to find a solution to what it seems an easy task but I do not manage to get it right. Any hint would be really appreciated!!

This is how I have setup the conditional for one selection (working)

conditionalPanel(
        "$('li.active a').first().html()!='Select Audience'",
      radioButtons("Sort", "Sort by:",
                   list("Reach" = 'Reach',
                        "Index" = 'Index')))

This is how I think it should be for two conditions (not working)
conditionalPanel(
        "$('li.active a').first().html()!='Select Audience' || 'Select Base'",
      radioButtons("Sort", "Sort by:",
                   list("Reach" = 'Reach',
